inputs.description: Path to .vipb to convert (relative to repo or absolute)
Output path for JSON (relative to repo or absolute)
Path to JSON patch file (relative to repo or absolute)
Output path for patched .vipb (relative to repo or absolute)

tasks.label: seed: help
args: docker compose -f "${workspaceFolder}/Tooling/docker/seed/docker-compose.yml" build seed; docker compose -f "${workspaceFolder}/Tooling/docker/seed/docker-compose.yml" run --rm -e INPUT_MODE=help seed

tasks.label: seed: shell
args: docker compose -f "${workspaceFolder}/Tooling/docker/seed/docker-compose.yml" build seed; docker compose -f "${workspaceFolder}/Tooling/docker/seed/docker-compose.yml" run --rm --entrypoint bash seed

tasks.label: seed: vipb -> json
args: $env:INPUT_MODE='vipb2json'; $env:INPUT_INPUT='/workspace/${input:seedVipbInput}'; $env:INPUT_OUTPUT='/workspace/${input:seedJsonOutput}'; docker compose -f "${workspaceFolder}/Tooling/docker/seed/docker-compose.yml" build seed; docker compose -f "${workspaceFolder}/Tooling/docker/seed/docker-compose.yml" run --rm -e INPUT_MODE -e INPUT_INPUT -e INPUT_OUTPUT seed

tasks.label: seed: apply patch
args: $env:INPUT_MODE='json2vipb'; $env:INPUT_INPUT='/workspace/${input:seedVipbInput}'; $env:INPUT_PATCH_FILE='/workspace/${input:seedPatchPath}'; $env:INPUT_OUTPUT='/workspace/${input:seedVipbOutput}'; docker compose -f "${workspaceFolder}/Tooling/docker/seed/docker-compose.yml" build seed; docker compose -f "${workspaceFolder}/Tooling/docker/seed/docker-compose.yml" run --rm -e INPUT_MODE -e INPUT_INPUT -e INPUT_PATCH_FILE -e INPUT_OUTPUT seed

tasks.label: seed + analyze: deep metadata check
args: & { Set-Location "${workspaceFolder}"; docker compose -f "./Tooling/docker/seed/docker-compose.yml" build seed; docker compose -f "./Tooling/docker/seed/docker-compose.yml" run --rm -e INPUT_MODE=vipb2json -e INPUT_INPUT=/workspace/Tooling/deployment/labview-icon-editor.vipb -e INPUT_OUTPUT=/workspace/artifacts/seed/metadata.json seed; pwsh -NoProfile -Command 'Invoke-Pester -Path "./Test/SeedMetadata.Tests.ps1" -CI'; $vip = Get-ChildItem -Path './builds','./builds-isolated' -Filter *.vip -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if(-not $vip){ throw "No .vip found under builds or builds-isolated." }; pwsh -NoProfile -File "./scripts/analyze-vi-package/run-local.ps1" -VipArtifactPath $vip.FullName -MinLabVIEW 21.0 }
